title: Conversion funnel
label: A water-slide cascade with one ramp per funnel stage: visit, sign up, trial, paid. Riders (each ten visitors) slide down; at every lip some splash into the pool under it, the drop-off at that stage, and the rest hop onto the next ramp. Each stage counts the riders that reach it, and the last pool fills with paying customers.
heading:
See exactly where
your visitors
fall off.
sub: Every rider is ten real visitors. Every pool is the people you lost at that step.
